 A quantity of water

nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.

antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword

steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.

Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions.

walls.

of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a north-south crawlway; a passage goes to the east also.
There is a hole above, but it provides no opportunities for climbing.
>You are in what appears to have been an artist's studio.  The walls
and floors are splattered with paints of 69 different colors. 
Strangely enough, nothing of value is hanging here.  At the north and
northwest of the room are open doors (also covered with paint).  An
extremely dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although
you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back
down.
>Kitchen

front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a north-south crawlway; a passage goes to the east also.
There is a hole above, but it provides no opportunities for climbing.
>You are in what appears to have been an artist's studio.  The walls
and floors are splattered with paints of 69 different colors. 
Strangely enough, nothing of value is hanging here.  At the north and
northwest of the room are open doors (also covered with paint).  An
extremely dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although
you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back
down.
>Kitchen
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the attic.  The only exit is stairs that lead down.
There is a square brick here which feels like clay.
A large coil of rope is lying in the corner.
On a table is a nasty-looking knife.
>Taken.

>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.

>You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off

>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading

Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.

axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.

extremely dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although
you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back
down.

>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>Beg pardon?
>

A sword

 A quantity of water

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>Beg pardon?
>

 A quantity of water

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a north-south crawlway; a passage goes to the east also.
There is a hole above, but it provides no opportunities for climbing.
>Beg pardon?
>

>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a north-south crawlway; a passage goes to the east also.
There is a hole above, but it provides no opportunities for climbing.
>Beg pardon?
>

This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden

This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded

>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,

>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there

>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have

A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden

nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.

>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.

Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.

out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.

>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.

axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a north-south crawlway; a passage goes to the east also.

>You are in what appears to have been an artist's studio.  The walls

extremely dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although
you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a north-south crawlway; a passage goes to the east also.
There is a hole above, but it provides no opportunities for climbing.
>You are in what appears to have been an artist's studio.  The walls
and floors are splattered with paints of 69 different colors. 
Strangely enough, nothing of value is hanging here.  At the north and
northwest of the room are open doors (also covered with paint).  An
extremely dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although
you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back
down.
>Kitchen
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Beg pardon?
>

Strangely enough, nothing of value is hanging here.  At the north and
northwest of the room are open doors (also covered with paint).  An
extremely dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although
you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back
down.
>Kitchen
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the attic.  The only exit is stairs that lead down.
There is a square brick here which feels like clay.
A large coil of rope is lying in the corner.
On a table is a nasty-looking knife.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a north-south crawlway; a passage goes to the east also.
There is a hole above, but it provides no opportunities for climbing.
>You are in what appears to have been an artist's studio.  The walls
and floors are splattered with paints of 69 different colors. 
Strangely enough, nothing of value is hanging here.  At the north and
northwest of the room are open doors (also covered with paint).  An
extremely dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although
you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back
down.
>Kitchen
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the attic.  The only exit is stairs that lead down.
There is a square brick here which feels like clay.
A large coil of rope is lying in the corner.
On a table is a nasty-looking knife.
>Taken.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Beg pardon?
>

The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a north-south crawlway; a passage goes to the east also.
There is a hole above, but it provides no opportunities for climbing.
>You are in what appears to have been an artist's studio.  The walls
and floors are splattered with paints of 69 different colors. 
Strangely enough, nothing of value is hanging here.  At the north and
northwest of the room are open doors (also covered with paint).  An
extremely dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although
you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back
down.
>Kitchen
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the attic.  The only exit is stairs that lead down.
There is a square brick here which feels like clay.
A large coil of rope is lying in the corner.
On a table is a nasty-looking knife.
>Taken.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Living Room
There is a trophy case here.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a north-south crawlway; a passage goes to the east also.
There is a hole above, but it provides no opportunities for climbing.
>You are in what appears to have been an artist's studio.  The walls
and floors are splattered with paints of 69 different colors. 
Strangely enough, nothing of value is hanging here.  At the north and
northwest of the room are open doors (also covered with paint).  An
extremely dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although
you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back
down.
>Kitchen
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the attic.  The only exit is stairs that lead down.
There is a square brick here which feels like clay.
A large coil of rope is lying in the corner.
On a table is a nasty-looking knife.
>Taken.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Living Room
There is a trophy case here.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>Cellar
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a north-south crawlway; a passage goes to the east also.
There is a hole above, but it provides no opportunities for climbing.
>You are in what appears to have been an artist's studio.  The walls
and floors are splattered with paints of 69 different colors. 
Strangely enough, nothing of value is hanging here.  At the north and
northwest of the room are open doors (also covered with paint).  An
extremely dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although
you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back
down.
>Kitchen
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the attic.  The only exit is stairs that lead down.
There is a square brick here which feels like clay.
A large coil of rope is lying in the corner.
On a table is a nasty-looking knife.
>Taken.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Living Room
There is a trophy case here.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>Cellar

>The Troll Room
>Beg pardon?

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a north-south crawlway; a passage goes to the east also.
There is a hole above, but it provides no opportunities for climbing.
>You are in what appears to have been an artist's studio.  The walls
and floors are splattered with paints of 69 different colors. 
Strangely enough, nothing of value is hanging here.  At the north and
northwest of the room are open doors (also covered with paint).  An
extremely dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although
you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back
down.
>Kitchen
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the attic.  The only exit is stairs that lead down.
There is a square brick here which feels like clay.
A large coil of rope is lying in the corner.
On a table is a nasty-looking knife.
>Taken.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Living Room
There is a trophy case here.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>Cellar
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
>The Troll Room
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a north-south crawlway; a passage goes to the east also.
There is a hole above, but it provides no opportunities for climbing.
>You are in what appears to have been an artist's studio.  The walls
and floors are splattered with paints of 69 different colors. 
Strangely enough, nothing of value is hanging here.  At the north and
northwest of the room are open doors (also covered with paint).  An
extremely dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although
you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back
down.
>Kitchen
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the attic.  The only exit is stairs that lead down.
There is a square brick here which feels like clay.
A large coil of rope is lying in the corner.
On a table is a nasty-looking knife.
>Taken.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Living Room
There is a trophy case here.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>Cellar
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
>The Troll Room
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a north-south crawlway; a passage goes to the east also.
There is a hole above, but it provides no opportunities for climbing.
>You are in what appears to have been an artist's studio.  The walls
and floors are splattered with paints of 69 different colors. 
Strangely enough, nothing of value is hanging here.  At the north and
northwest of the room are open doors (also covered with paint).  An
extremely dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although
you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back
down.
>Kitchen
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the attic.  The only exit is stairs that lead down.
There is a square brick here which feels like clay.
A large coil of rope is lying in the corner.
On a table is a nasty-looking knife.
>Taken.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Living Room
There is a trophy case here.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>Cellar
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
>The Troll Room
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.
There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway
climbing up along the edge of a cliff.
>Beg pardon?
>

>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a north-south crawlway; a passage goes to the east also.
There is a hole above, but it provides no opportunities for climbing.
>You are in what appears to have been an artist's studio.  The walls
and floors are splattered with paints of 69 different colors. 
Strangely enough, nothing of value is hanging here.  At the north and
northwest of the room are open doors (also covered with paint).  An
extremely dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although
you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back
down.
>Kitchen
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the attic.  The only exit is stairs that lead down.
There is a square brick here which feels like clay.
A large coil of rope is lying in the corner.
On a table is a nasty-looking knife.
>Taken.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Living Room
There is a trophy case here.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>Cellar
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
>The Troll Room
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.
There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway
climbing up along the edge of a cliff.
>You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>Beg pardon?
>

>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,

>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there

>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have

the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.

A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water

nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.

>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.

Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.

walls.

 A quantity of water

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a north-south crawlway; a passage goes to the east also.
There is a hole above, but it provides no opportunities for climbing.
>You are in what appears to have been an artist's studio.  The walls
and floors are splattered with paints of 69 different colors. 
Strangely enough, nothing of value is hanging here.  At the north and
northwest of the room are open doors (also covered with paint).  An
extremely dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although
you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back
down.
>Kitchen
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the attic.  The only exit is stairs that lead down.
There is a square brick here which feels like clay.
A large coil of rope is lying in the corner.
On a table is a nasty-looking knife.
>Taken.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Living Room
There is a trophy case here.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>Cellar
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
>The Troll Room
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.
There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway
climbing up along the edge of a cliff.
>You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
>This room appears to have been the waiting room for groups touring
the dam.  There are exits here to the north and east marked
'Private', though the doors are open, and an exit to the south.
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>Beg pardon?
>

>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.

>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.

carcass has disappeared.

>You are in a north-south crawlway; a passage goes to the east also.

northwest of the room are open doors (also covered with paint).  An
extremely dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although
you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back
down.

 A quantity of water

>Taken.

>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.

>You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off

>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was

The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a north-south crawlway; a passage goes to the east also.
There is a hole above, but it provides no opportunities for climbing.
>You are in what appears to have been an artist's studio.  The walls
and floors are splattered with paints of 69 different colors. 
Strangely enough, nothing of value is hanging here.  At the north and
northwest of the room are open doors (also covered with paint).  An
extremely dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although
you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back
down.
>Kitchen
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the attic.  The only exit is stairs that lead down.
There is a square brick here which feels like clay.
A large coil of rope is lying in the corner.
On a table is a nasty-looking knife.
>Taken.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Living Room
There is a trophy case here.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>Cellar
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
>The Troll Room
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.
There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway
climbing up along the edge of a cliff.
>You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
>This room appears to have been the waiting room for groups touring
the dam.  There are exits here to the north and east marked
'Private', though the doors are open, and an exit to the south.
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>Taken.
>Beg pardon?
>
