Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a north-south crawlway; a passage goes to the east also.
There is a hole above, but it provides no opportunities for climbing.
>You are in what appears to have been an artist's studio.  The walls
and floors are splattered with paints of 69 different colors. 
Strangely enough, nothing of value is hanging here.  At the north and
northwest of the room are open doors (also covered with paint).  An
extremely dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although
you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back
down.
>Kitchen
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the attic.  The only exit is stairs that lead down.
There is a square brick here which feels like clay.
A large coil of rope is lying in the corner.
On a table is a nasty-looking knife.
>Taken.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Living Room
There is a trophy case here.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>Cellar
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
>The Troll Room
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.
There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway
climbing up along the edge of a cliff.
>You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
>This room appears to have been the waiting room for groups touring
the dam.  There are exits here to the north and east marked
'Private', though the doors are open, and an exit to the south.
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>Dam
>Deep Canyon
>Reservoir South
>Deep Ravine
>You are in a crawlway with a three-foot high ceiling.  Your footing
is very unsure here due to the assortment of rocks underfoot. 
Passages can be seen in the east, west, and northwest corners of the
passage.
>You are at the periphery of a large dome, which forms the ceiling
of another room below.  Protecting you from a precipitous drop is a
wooden railing which circles the dome.
>The rope drops over the side and comes within ten feet of the floor.
>You are in a large room with a prominent doorway leading to a down
staircase. To the west is a narrow twisting tunnel.  Above you is a
large dome painted with scenes depicting elfin hacking rites. Up
around the edge of the dome (20 feet up) is a wooden railing. In the
center of the room there is a white marble pedestal.
A large piece of rope descends from the railing above, ending some
five feet above your head.
Sitting on the pedestal is a flaming torch, made of ivory.
>Taken.
>North-South Crawlway
>The Troll Room
>East-West Passage
>Deep Ravine
>Rocky Crawl
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a north-south crawlway; a passage goes to the east also.
There is a hole above, but it provides no opportunities for climbing.
>You are in what appears to have been an artist's studio.  The walls
and floors are splattered with paints of 69 different colors. 
Strangely enough, nothing of value is hanging here.  At the north and
northwest of the room are open doors (also covered with paint).  An
extremely dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although
you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back
down.
>Kitchen
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the attic.  The only exit is stairs that lead down.
There is a square brick here which feels like clay.
A large coil of rope is lying in the corner.
On a table is a nasty-looking knife.
>Taken.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Living Room
There is a trophy case here.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>Cellar
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
>The Troll Room
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.
There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway
climbing up along the edge of a cliff.
>You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
>This room appears to have been the waiting room for groups touring
the dam.  There are exits here to the north and east marked
'Private', though the doors are open, and an exit to the south.
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>Dam
>Deep Canyon
>Reservoir South
>Deep Ravine
>You are in a crawlway with a three-foot high ceiling.  Your footing
is very unsure here due to the assortment of rocks underfoot. 
Passages can be seen in the east, west, and northwest corners of the
passage.
>You are at the periphery of a large dome, which forms the ceiling
of another room below.  Protecting you from a precipitous drop is a
wooden railing which circles the dome.
>The rope drops over the side and comes within ten feet of the floor.
>You are in a large room with a prominent doorway leading to a down
staircase. To the west is a narrow twisting tunnel.  Above you is a
large dome painted with scenes depicting elfin hacking rites. Up
around the edge of the dome (20 feet up) is a wooden railing. In the
center of the room there is a white marble pedestal.
A large piece of rope descends from the railing above, ending some
five feet above your head.
Sitting on the pedestal is a flaming torch, made of ivory.
>Taken.
>North-South Crawlway
>The Troll Room
>East-West Passage
>Deep Ravine
>Rocky Crawl
>You are in a room which looks like an Egyptian tomb.  There is an
ascending staircase in the room as well as doors, east and south.
There is a solid-gold coffin, used for the burial of Ramses II, here.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a north-south crawlway; a passage goes to the east also.
There is a hole above, but it provides no opportunities for climbing.
>You are in what appears to have been an artist's studio.  The walls
and floors are splattered with paints of 69 different colors. 
Strangely enough, nothing of value is hanging here.  At the north and
northwest of the room are open doors (also covered with paint).  An
extremely dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although
you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back
down.
>Kitchen
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the attic.  The only exit is stairs that lead down.
There is a square brick here which feels like clay.
A large coil of rope is lying in the corner.
On a table is a nasty-looking knife.
>Taken.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Living Room
There is a trophy case here.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>Cellar
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
>The Troll Room
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.
There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway
climbing up along the edge of a cliff.
>You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
>This room appears to have been the waiting room for groups touring
the dam.  There are exits here to the north and east marked
'Private', though the doors are open, and an exit to the south.
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>Dam
>Deep Canyon
>Reservoir South
>Deep Ravine
>You are in a crawlway with a three-foot high ceiling.  Your footing
is very unsure here due to the assortment of rocks underfoot. 
Passages can be seen in the east, west, and northwest corners of the
passage.
>You are at the periphery of a large dome, which forms the ceiling
of another room below.  Protecting you from a precipitous drop is a
wooden railing which circles the dome.
>The rope drops over the side and comes within ten feet of the floor.
>You are in a large room with a prominent doorway leading to a down
staircase. To the west is a narrow twisting tunnel.  Above you is a
large dome painted with scenes depicting elfin hacking rites. Up
around the edge of the dome (20 feet up) is a wooden railing. In the
center of the room there is a white marble pedestal.
A large piece of rope descends from the railing above, ending some
five feet above your head.
Sitting on the pedestal is a flaming torch, made of ivory.
>Taken.
>North-South Crawlway
>The Troll Room
>East-West Passage
>Deep Ravine
>Rocky Crawl
>You are in a room which looks like an Egyptian tomb.  There is an
ascending staircase in the room as well as doors, east and south.
There is a solid-gold coffin, used for the burial of Ramses II, here.
>You are in a large room, with giant icicles hanging from the walls
and ceiling.  There are passages to the north and east.
A mass of ice fills the western half of the room.
>Beg pardon?
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a north-south crawlway; a passage goes to the east also.
There is a hole above, but it provides no opportunities for climbing.
>You are in what appears to have been an artist's studio.  The walls
and floors are splattered with paints of 69 different colors. 
Strangely enough, nothing of value is hanging here.  At the north and
northwest of the room are open doors (also covered with paint).  An
extremely dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although
you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back
down.
>Kitchen
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the attic.  The only exit is stairs that lead down.
There is a square brick here which feels like clay.
A large coil of rope is lying in the corner.
On a table is a nasty-looking knife.
>Taken.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Living Room
There is a trophy case here.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>Cellar
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
>The Troll Room
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.
There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway
climbing up along the edge of a cliff.
>You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
>This room appears to have been the waiting room for groups touring
the dam.  There are exits here to the north and east marked
'Private', though the doors are open, and an exit to the south.
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>Dam
>Deep Canyon
>Reservoir South
>Deep Ravine
>You are in a crawlway with a three-foot high ceiling.  Your footing
is very unsure here due to the assortment of rocks underfoot. 
Passages can be seen in the east, west, and northwest corners of the
passage.
>You are at the periphery of a large dome, which forms the ceiling
of another room below.  Protecting you from a precipitous drop is a
wooden railing which circles the dome.
>The rope drops over the side and comes within ten feet of the floor.
>You are in a large room with a prominent doorway leading to a down
staircase. To the west is a narrow twisting tunnel.  Above you is a
large dome painted with scenes depicting elfin hacking rites. Up
around the edge of the dome (20 feet up) is a wooden railing. In the
center of the room there is a white marble pedestal.
A large piece of rope descends from the railing above, ending some
five feet above your head.
Sitting on the pedestal is a flaming torch, made of ivory.
>Taken.
>North-South Crawlway
>The Troll Room
>East-West Passage
>Deep Ravine
>Rocky Crawl
>You are in a room which looks like an Egyptian tomb.  There is an
ascending staircase in the room as well as doors, east and south.
There is a solid-gold coffin, used for the burial of Ramses II, here.
>You are in a large room, with giant icicles hanging from the walls
and ceiling.  There are passages to the north and east.
A mass of ice fills the western half of the room.
>The torch hits the glacier and explodes into a great ball of flame,
devouring the glacier.  The water from the melting glacier rushes
downstream, carrying the torch with it.  In the place of the glacier,
there is a passageway leading west.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>Beg pardon?
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a north-south crawlway; a passage goes to the east also.
There is a hole above, but it provides no opportunities for climbing.
>You are in what appears to have been an artist's studio.  The walls
and floors are splattered with paints of 69 different colors. 
Strangely enough, nothing of value is hanging here.  At the north and
northwest of the room are open doors (also covered with paint).  An
extremely dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although
you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back
down.
>Kitchen
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the attic.  The only exit is stairs that lead down.
There is a square brick here which feels like clay.
A large coil of rope is lying in the corner.
On a table is a nasty-looking knife.
>Taken.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Living Room
There is a trophy case here.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>Cellar
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
>The Troll Room
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.
There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway
climbing up along the edge of a cliff.
>You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
>This room appears to have been the waiting room for groups touring
the dam.  There are exits here to the north and east marked
'Private', though the doors are open, and an exit to the south.
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>Dam
>Deep Canyon
>Reservoir South
>Deep Ravine
>You are in a crawlway with a three-foot high ceiling.  Your footing
is very unsure here due to the assortment of rocks underfoot. 
Passages can be seen in the east, west, and northwest corners of the
passage.
>You are at the periphery of a large dome, which forms the ceiling
of another room below.  Protecting you from a precipitous drop is a
wooden railing which circles the dome.
>The rope drops over the side and comes within ten feet of the floor.
>You are in a large room with a prominent doorway leading to a down
staircase. To the west is a narrow twisting tunnel.  Above you is a
large dome painted with scenes depicting elfin hacking rites. Up
around the edge of the dome (20 feet up) is a wooden railing. In the
center of the room there is a white marble pedestal.
A large piece of rope descends from the railing above, ending some
five feet above your head.
Sitting on the pedestal is a flaming torch, made of ivory.
>Taken.
>North-South Crawlway
>The Troll Room
>East-West Passage
>Deep Ravine
>Rocky Crawl
>You are in a room which looks like an Egyptian tomb.  There is an
ascending staircase in the room as well as doors, east and south.
There is a solid-gold coffin, used for the burial of Ramses II, here.
>You are in a large room, with giant icicles hanging from the walls
and ceiling.  There are passages to the north and east.
A mass of ice fills the western half of the room.
>The torch hits the glacier and explodes into a great ball of flame,
devouring the glacier.  The water from the melting glacier rushes
downstream, carrying the torch with it.  In the place of the glacier,
there is a passageway leading west.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small chamber behind the remains of the Great Glacier.
To the south and west are small passageways.
On the floor lies a moby ruby.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Beg pardon?
Someone carrying a large bag is casually leaning against one of the
walls here.  He does not speak, but it is clear from his aspect that
the bag will be taken only over his dead body.
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a north-south crawlway; a passage goes to the east also.
There is a hole above, but it provides no opportunities for climbing.
>You are in what appears to have been an artist's studio.  The walls
and floors are splattered with paints of 69 different colors. 
Strangely enough, nothing of value is hanging here.  At the north and
northwest of the room are open doors (also covered with paint).  An
extremely dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although
you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back
down.
>Kitchen
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the attic.  The only exit is stairs that lead down.
There is a square brick here which feels like clay.
A large coil of rope is lying in the corner.
On a table is a nasty-looking knife.
>Taken.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Living Room
There is a trophy case here.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>Cellar
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
>The Troll Room
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.
There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway
climbing up along the edge of a cliff.
>You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
>This room appears to have been the waiting room for groups touring
the dam.  There are exits here to the north and east marked
'Private', though the doors are open, and an exit to the south.
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>Dam
>Deep Canyon
>Reservoir South
>Deep Ravine
>You are in a crawlway with a three-foot high ceiling.  Your footing
is very unsure here due to the assortment of rocks underfoot. 
Passages can be seen in the east, west, and northwest corners of the
passage.
>You are at the periphery of a large dome, which forms the ceiling
of another room below.  Protecting you from a precipitous drop is a
wooden railing which circles the dome.
>The rope drops over the side and comes within ten feet of the floor.
>You are in a large room with a prominent doorway leading to a down
staircase. To the west is a narrow twisting tunnel.  Above you is a
large dome painted with scenes depicting elfin hacking rites. Up
around the edge of the dome (20 feet up) is a wooden railing. In the
center of the room there is a white marble pedestal.
A large piece of rope descends from the railing above, ending some
five feet above your head.
Sitting on the pedestal is a flaming torch, made of ivory.
>Taken.
>North-South Crawlway
>The Troll Room
>East-West Passage
>Deep Ravine
>Rocky Crawl
>You are in a room which looks like an Egyptian tomb.  There is an
ascending staircase in the room as well as doors, east and south.
There is a solid-gold coffin, used for the burial of Ramses II, here.
>You are in a large room, with giant icicles hanging from the walls
and ceiling.  There are passages to the north and east.
A mass of ice fills the western half of the room.
>The torch hits the glacier and explodes into a great ball of flame,
devouring the glacier.  The water from the melting glacier rushes
downstream, carrying the torch with it.  In the place of the glacier,
there is a passageway leading west.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small chamber behind the remains of the Great Glacier.
To the south and west are small passageways.
On the floor lies a moby ruby.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>You are in a small room, whose walls are formed by an old lava flow.
There are exits here to the west and the south.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a north-south crawlway; a passage goes to the east also.
There is a hole above, but it provides no opportunities for climbing.
>You are in what appears to have been an artist's studio.  The walls
and floors are splattered with paints of 69 different colors. 
Strangely enough, nothing of value is hanging here.  At the north and
northwest of the room are open doors (also covered with paint).  An
extremely dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although
you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back
down.
>Kitchen
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the attic.  The only exit is stairs that lead down.
There is a square brick here which feels like clay.
A large coil of rope is lying in the corner.
On a table is a nasty-looking knife.
>Taken.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Living Room
There is a trophy case here.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>Cellar
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
>The Troll Room
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.
There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway
climbing up along the edge of a cliff.
>You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
>This room appears to have been the waiting room for groups touring
the dam.  There are exits here to the north and east marked
'Private', though the doors are open, and an exit to the south.
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>Dam
>Deep Canyon
>Reservoir South
>Deep Ravine
>You are in a crawlway with a three-foot high ceiling.  Your footing
is very unsure here due to the assortment of rocks underfoot. 
Passages can be seen in the east, west, and northwest corners of the
passage.
>You are at the periphery of a large dome, which forms the ceiling
of another room below.  Protecting you from a precipitous drop is a
wooden railing which circles the dome.
>The rope drops over the side and comes within ten feet of the floor.
>You are in a large room with a prominent doorway leading to a down
staircase. To the west is a narrow twisting tunnel.  Above you is a
large dome painted with scenes depicting elfin hacking rites. Up
around the edge of the dome (20 feet up) is a wooden railing. In the
center of the room there is a white marble pedestal.
A large piece of rope descends from the railing above, ending some
five feet above your head.
Sitting on the pedestal is a flaming torch, made of ivory.
>Taken.
>North-South Crawlway
>The Troll Room
>East-West Passage
>Deep Ravine
>Rocky Crawl
>You are in a room which looks like an Egyptian tomb.  There is an
ascending staircase in the room as well as doors, east and south.
There is a solid-gold coffin, used for the burial of Ramses II, here.
>You are in a large room, with giant icicles hanging from the walls
and ceiling.  There are passages to the north and east.
A mass of ice fills the western half of the room.
>The torch hits the glacier and explodes into a great ball of flame,
devouring the glacier.  The water from the melting glacier rushes
downstream, carrying the torch with it.  In the place of the glacier,
there is a passageway leading west.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small chamber behind the remains of the Great Glacier.
To the south and west are small passageways.
On the floor lies a moby ruby.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>You are in a small room, whose walls are formed by an old lava flow.
There are exits here to the west and the south.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are at the bottom of a large dormant volcano.  High above you
light may be seen entering from the cone of the volcano.  The only
exit here is to the north.
There is a very large and extremely heavy wicker basket with a cloth
bag here. Inside the basket is a metal receptacle of some kind. 
Attached to the basket on the outside is a piece of wire.
The basket contains:
 A cloth bag
 A braided wire
 A receptacle
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a north-south crawlway; a passage goes to the east also.
There is a hole above, but it provides no opportunities for climbing.
>You are in what appears to have been an artist's studio.  The walls
and floors are splattered with paints of 69 different colors. 
Strangely enough, nothing of value is hanging here.  At the north and
northwest of the room are open doors (also covered with paint).  An
extremely dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although
you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back
down.
>Kitchen
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the attic.  The only exit is stairs that lead down.
There is a square brick here which feels like clay.
A large coil of rope is lying in the corner.
On a table is a nasty-looking knife.
>Taken.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Living Room
There is a trophy case here.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>Cellar
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
>The Troll Room
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.
There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway
climbing up along the edge of a cliff.
>You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
>This room appears to have been the waiting room for groups touring
the dam.  There are exits here to the north and east marked
'Private', though the doors are open, and an exit to the south.
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>Dam
>Deep Canyon
>Reservoir South
>Deep Ravine
>You are in a crawlway with a three-foot high ceiling.  Your footing
is very unsure here due to the assortment of rocks underfoot. 
Passages can be seen in the east, west, and northwest corners of the
passage.
>You are at the periphery of a large dome, which forms the ceiling
of another room below.  Protecting you from a precipitous drop is a
wooden railing which circles the dome.
>The rope drops over the side and comes within ten feet of the floor.
>You are in a large room with a prominent doorway leading to a down
staircase. To the west is a narrow twisting tunnel.  Above you is a
large dome painted with scenes depicting elfin hacking rites. Up
around the edge of the dome (20 feet up) is a wooden railing. In the
center of the room there is a white marble pedestal.
A large piece of rope descends from the railing above, ending some
five feet above your head.
Sitting on the pedestal is a flaming torch, made of ivory.
>Taken.
>North-South Crawlway
>The Troll Room
>East-West Passage
>Deep Ravine
>Rocky Crawl
>You are in a room which looks like an Egyptian tomb.  There is an
ascending staircase in the room as well as doors, east and south.
There is a solid-gold coffin, used for the burial of Ramses II, here.
>You are in a large room, with giant icicles hanging from the walls
and ceiling.  There are passages to the north and east.
A mass of ice fills the western half of the room.
>The torch hits the glacier and explodes into a great ball of flame,
devouring the glacier.  The water from the melting glacier rushes
downstream, carrying the torch with it.  In the place of the glacier,
there is a passageway leading west.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small chamber behind the remains of the Great Glacier.
To the south and west are small passageways.
On the floor lies a moby ruby.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>You are in a small room, whose walls are formed by an old lava flow.
There are exits here to the west and the south.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are at the bottom of a large dormant volcano.  High above you
light may be seen entering from the cone of the volcano.  The only
exit here is to the north.
There is a very large and extremely heavy wicker basket with a cloth
bag here. Inside the basket is a metal receptacle of some kind. 
Attached to the basket on the outside is a piece of wire.
The basket contains:
 A cloth bag
 A braided wire
 A receptacle
>Opened.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a north-south crawlway; a passage goes to the east also.
There is a hole above, but it provides no opportunities for climbing.
>You are in what appears to have been an artist's studio.  The walls
and floors are splattered with paints of 69 different colors. 
Strangely enough, nothing of value is hanging here.  At the north and
northwest of the room are open doors (also covered with paint).  An
extremely dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although
you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back
down.
>Kitchen
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the attic.  The only exit is stairs that lead down.
There is a square brick here which feels like clay.
A large coil of rope is lying in the corner.
On a table is a nasty-looking knife.
>Taken.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Living Room
There is a trophy case here.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>Cellar
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
>The Troll Room
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.
There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway
climbing up along the edge of a cliff.
>You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
>This room appears to have been the waiting room for groups touring
the dam.  There are exits here to the north and east marked
'Private', though the doors are open, and an exit to the south.
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>Dam
>Deep Canyon
>Reservoir South
>Deep Ravine
>You are in a crawlway with a three-foot high ceiling.  Your footing
is very unsure here due to the assortment of rocks underfoot. 
Passages can be seen in the east, west, and northwest corners of the
passage.
>You are at the periphery of a large dome, which forms the ceiling
of another room below.  Protecting you from a precipitous drop is a
wooden railing which circles the dome.
>The rope drops over the side and comes within ten feet of the floor.
>You are in a large room with a prominent doorway leading to a down
staircase. To the west is a narrow twisting tunnel.  Above you is a
large dome painted with scenes depicting elfin hacking rites. Up
around the edge of the dome (20 feet up) is a wooden railing. In the
center of the room there is a white marble pedestal.
A large piece of rope descends from the railing above, ending some
five feet above your head.
Sitting on the pedestal is a flaming torch, made of ivory.
>Taken.
>North-South Crawlway
>The Troll Room
>East-West Passage
>Deep Ravine
>Rocky Crawl
>You are in a room which looks like an Egyptian tomb.  There is an
ascending staircase in the room as well as doors, east and south.
There is a solid-gold coffin, used for the burial of Ramses II, here.
>You are in a large room, with giant icicles hanging from the walls
and ceiling.  There are passages to the north and east.
A mass of ice fills the western half of the room.
>The torch hits the glacier and explodes into a great ball of flame,
devouring the glacier.  The water from the melting glacier rushes
downstream, carrying the torch with it.  In the place of the glacier,
there is a passageway leading west.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small chamber behind the remains of the Great Glacier.
To the south and west are small passageways.
On the floor lies a moby ruby.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>You are in a small room, whose walls are formed by an old lava flow.
There are exits here to the west and the south.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are at the bottom of a large dormant volcano.  High above you
light may be seen entering from the cone of the volcano.  The only
exit here is to the north.
There is a very large and extremely heavy wicker basket with a cloth
bag here. Inside the basket is a metal receptacle of some kind. 
Attached to the basket on the outside is a piece of wire.
The basket contains:
 A cloth bag
 A braided wire
 A receptacle
>Opened.
>Done.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a north-south crawlway; a passage goes to the east also.
There is a hole above, but it provides no opportunities for climbing.
>You are in what appears to have been an artist's studio.  The walls
and floors are splattered with paints of 69 different colors. 
Strangely enough, nothing of value is hanging here.  At the north and
northwest of the room are open doors (also covered with paint).  An
extremely dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although
you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back
down.
>Kitchen
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the attic.  The only exit is stairs that lead down.
There is a square brick here which feels like clay.
A large coil of rope is lying in the corner.
On a table is a nasty-looking knife.
>Taken.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Living Room
There is a trophy case here.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>Cellar
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
>The Troll Room
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.
There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway
climbing up along the edge of a cliff.
>You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
>This room appears to have been the waiting room for groups touring
the dam.  There are exits here to the north and east marked
'Private', though the doors are open, and an exit to the south.
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>Dam
>Deep Canyon
>Reservoir South
>Deep Ravine
>You are in a crawlway with a three-foot high ceiling.  Your footing
is very unsure here due to the assortment of rocks underfoot. 
Passages can be seen in the east, west, and northwest corners of the
passage.
>You are at the periphery of a large dome, which forms the ceiling
of another room below.  Protecting you from a precipitous drop is a
wooden railing which circles the dome.
>The rope drops over the side and comes within ten feet of the floor.
>You are in a large room with a prominent doorway leading to a down
staircase. To the west is a narrow twisting tunnel.  Above you is a
large dome painted with scenes depicting elfin hacking rites. Up
around the edge of the dome (20 feet up) is a wooden railing. In the
center of the room there is a white marble pedestal.
A large piece of rope descends from the railing above, ending some
five feet above your head.
Sitting on the pedestal is a flaming torch, made of ivory.
>Taken.
>North-South Crawlway
>The Troll Room
>East-West Passage
>Deep Ravine
>Rocky Crawl
>You are in a room which looks like an Egyptian tomb.  There is an
ascending staircase in the room as well as doors, east and south.
There is a solid-gold coffin, used for the burial of Ramses II, here.
>You are in a large room, with giant icicles hanging from the walls
and ceiling.  There are passages to the north and east.
A mass of ice fills the western half of the room.
>The torch hits the glacier and explodes into a great ball of flame,
devouring the glacier.  The water from the melting glacier rushes
downstream, carrying the torch with it.  In the place of the glacier,
there is a passageway leading west.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small chamber behind the remains of the Great Glacier.
To the south and west are small passageways.
On the floor lies a moby ruby.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>You are in a small room, whose walls are formed by an old lava flow.
There are exits here to the west and the south.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are at the bottom of a large dormant volcano.  High above you
light may be seen entering from the cone of the volcano.  The only
exit here is to the north.
There is a very large and extremely heavy wicker basket with a cloth
bag here. Inside the basket is a metal receptacle of some kind. 
Attached to the basket on the outside is a piece of wire.
The basket contains:
 A cloth bag
 A braided wire
 A receptacle
>Opened.
>Done.
>You are in the basket.
>Beg pardon?
>
